reviews.title: Expensify – Duplicate Charges, Terrible Support, and Frustrating Cancellation
reviews.text:
Rating: 1 out of 5 stars

My experience with Expensify was extremely frustrating. While the receipt-tracking features were decent, the billing practices, customer support, and cancellation process were terrible.

I originally signed up through my iPhone but was repeatedly directed to their website to complete account setup. I ended up being charged through both the Apple App Store and Expensify directly, despite using the same email address.

I also spent considerable time trying to set up their corporate card. Even though I qualified and used a well-known bank, the process never worked properly. Support was consistently unhelpful, and I kept my account open longer than intended while trying to resolve these issues.

Canceling was another headache. I had two workspaces and couldn’t cancel without first downgrading to one. That process resulted in another full month’s charge at a higher rate, just to get my account into a position where I could cancel.

When I requested refunds for the duplicate charges, Expensify initially indicated they would review the discrepancies. Meanwhile, the time spent trying to resolve their issues pushed me beyond Apple’s refund window. In the end, neither company refunded the additional charges.

Bottom line: Expensify’s receipt tracking was decent, but the duplicate billing, poor support, corporate card setup problems, and difficult cancellation process made the service not worth it.

I would not recommend Expensify to other small business owners

reviews.title: Awful.  Used to be great.
reviews.text:
This was my go to solution for receipt archival and expense reporting and management for years.  But in the past year, it’s become almost unusable. 

The app forces an update roughly every month. Fine. But said updates require you to sign back in to the app, with TWO onerous authentication steps that usually don’t work abroad. 

Here’s the use case: I’ve just had dinner, and I want to memorialize the receipt using the app. Easy, right?  WRONG!!!  I’m forced to update the app, and if I’m traveling abroad, I have to do that on data or over Wi-Fi… Which of itself takes forever.  Then they have to send a code to my email, which is another wait. And frequently there’s a long delay.  Then, because I’m not having enough fun yet, they require me to use an authenticator.

Meanwhile, 20 minutes, have gone by, and all I wanna do is upload an image of my receipt

Jesus, people.  Get your act together.   When I update my banking apps, which have vastly more sensitive and important information, I’m not required to log back in again. 

Just torture.  Find an alternative.  I know I will.

reviews.title: Expensify is the Worst!
reviews.text:
I’ve never been more frustrated with a finance app than I am with Expensify. What should be a straightforward tool for tracking expenses feels unnecessarily complicated and poorly thought out. The layout is cluttered and unintuitive, making even the most basic features hard to find. Simple tasks like submitting a receipt or generating a report take far too many steps, and half the time it’s not clear whether you’ve even completed the process correctly.
The user interface feels outdated and disorganized, with menus buried inside other menus for no apparent reason. Instead of streamlining expense management, the app turns it into a time-consuming chore. Very simple actions require far too much time and quickly become frustratingly difficult. Overall, it feels like the app was designed without real users in mind. I expected efficiency and clarity, but got confusion and wasted time instead.

reviews.title: Evil Company
reviews.text:
Evil, predatory company – AVOID AT ALL COSTS! Do NOT subscribe!
Expensify is straight-up evil. They trap you in their annual subscription with no way to terminate early. Even if you stop using the service completely, they force you to keep paying month after month until the full renewal period ends. The only “solution” is to disable auto-renew (so it doesn’t roll over again), but you’re still stuck bleeding money for the remaining term. Then, finally, you can delete the workspace and stop payments – but only after they’ve squeezed every last dollar out of you.
This isn’t a mistake; it’s their deliberate policy to lock people in and make canceling a nightmare. Don’t fall for it – there are plenty of better expense tools out there that don’t treat customers like hostages. Stay far away from Expensify!

reviews.title: Horrible update
reviews.text: An update was recently made to this app that makes it essentially unusable. It’s very slow to load, unstable and very buggy. Multiple entries are also created when trying to enter an expense. They should highly consider reverting back to the previous build and bring in a new development team to rework this entire app and perform QA. The user experience also horrible as they’ve now made it a lengthy process to enter an expense, including redundant steps. Very poorly thought out. My company is now highly considering switching to an entirely different platform for expense management. I highly recommend those that are considering Expensify to choose an alternative until they fix these issues and then reconsider them. It’s not worth the instability and trouble. More than likely, there are probably security issues as well. Take this warning seriously.
